schema.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name

rows.name: metadata
rows.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

rows.name: order_items
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
          item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id),
          product TEXT NOT NULL, amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents >= 0))

rows.name: orders
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (
          order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL,
          created_at TEXT NOT NULL, paid_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL,
          is_test INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_test IN (0,1)),
          amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents >= 0))

rows.name: refunds
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE refunds (
          refund_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id),
          refunded_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
          amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents > 0))

status.query: SELECT status,is_test,COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status,is_test ORDER BY status,is_test

boundary.query: SELECT order_id,created_at,paid_at FROM orders WHERE order_id IN ('O10','O11','O12') ORDER BY order_id

refunds.query: SELECT * FROM refunds ORDER BY refund_id

grain.query: SELECT o.order_id,COUNT(i.item_id) AS items,COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(order_id) GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id

units.query: SELECT typeof(amount_cents) AS storage_type,MIN(amount_cents) AS minimum,MAX(amount_cents) AS maximum FROM orders GROUP BY typeof(amount_cents)
